taskTypes.passkeys_types: Set what a passkey may approve

passkeyTypes.title: What a passkey may approve
passkeyTypes.hint: Each action either works with a passkey, from a phone too, or needs a signature from hauswart-admin or the admin app. A change reaches the protected devices only after you sign it with hauswart-admin approve: a passkey cannot widen its own reach.
passkeyTypes.notChosen: Nobody chose yet, so every device keeps the list it was enrolled with. This shows the default.
passkeyTypes.saved: Saved. Sign the change with hauswart-admin approve.

risk.pkg_remove: Can remove anything, the agent and the firewall too.
risk.pkg_upgrade: Updates what the device's repositories offer.
risk.flatpak_install: Apps from Flathub with the permissions they ask for.
risk.power_shutdown: The device stays off until someone switches it on.
risk.screen_extend: More screen time, for today only.
risk.terminal_open: A root shell for up to four hours, started within 15 minutes.
risk.access_lock: Locks the screen, for at most a day.
risk.access_deny: Refuses logins and ends sessions, for at most a day.
risk.access_cover: Covers the screen with a notice, for at most a day.
risk.access_open: Opens the device again after a block.
